name: Umbraco
description: Umbraco is an open-source, .NET-based content management system that lets developers and editors build and manage websites with flexible content modeling.
best_for: .NET development teams and editors who want an open-source, editor-friendly CMS built on the latest .NET technology.
features: Content modeling with schema definition and property editor configuration
Editor-friendly publishing workflows and user management
Multilingual and localization configuration for international sites
Extensible backoffice with server-side customization and package building
Frontend developer APIs for headless and coupled integrations

alternatives.name: WordPress
alternatives.description: The world's most widely used CMS, powering everything from blogs to large-scale websites with a vast plugin and theme ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Individuals and businesses of all sizes needing a flexible, widely supported CMS

alternatives.name: Drupal
alternatives.description: An open-source, API-first CMS for building structured, composable digital experiences across websites and channels.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises and institutions needing a highly customizable, secure CMS

alternatives.name: Joomla
alternatives.description: An open-source CMS built entirely by volunteers, offering multilingual support and flexible permission structures.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations needing multilingual sites and granular user permissions
